decks.notes: The deck focuses on playing aggressively with Death's Shadow in order to reduce one's own life total to maximize its power. It includes cards like Street Wraith and Thoughtseize to facilitate this strategy, while also including countermagic like Daze and Force of Will to protect key threats. The deck also features a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and Snuff Out to control the board, along with cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder for card selection. The inclusion of Reanimate allows for additional ways to bring back threats quickly, while cards like Orcish Bowmasters provide additional utility in dealing with opposing creatures.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize cheap and efficient spells like Delver of Secrets, Lightning Bolt, and Wasteland to control the tempo of the game while disrupting the opponent's plays. By combining aggressive creatures like Murktide Regent and Dragon's Rage Channeler with counterspells and card draw spells like Ponder and Brainstorm, this deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent while maintaining card advantage and flexibility in its plays. The mana base is optimized for consistent casting of spells and to support the deck's strategy of being fast and disruptive.

The main concept of this Legacy Mono Black Combo deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy by using cards like Leyline of the Void and Thoughtseize, while also assembling the Helm of Obedience combo to mill cards from the opponent's library. The deck utilizes fast mana sources like Dark Ritual and Ancient Tomb to power out powerful threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. Additionally, cards like Opposition Agent and Dauthi Voidwalker provide disruption and protection for the combo strategy. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and win through a powerful combo finish.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling a winning combo by utilizing the cards Step Through and Paradigm Shift. It aims to manipulate the deck with cards like Impulse and Preordain, while also generating fast mana with Lotus Petal and Ancient Tomb. The deck includes disruptive elements such as Narset, Parter of Veils and Hullbreacher to slow down opponents. The combo win condition is achieved with Thought Lash and Thassa's Oracle, allowing the deck to exile the entire library and win the game. The deck also includes cards like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will for additional control and protection.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays with a combination of disruption and efficient creatures. It utilizes a mix of cheap removal spells and countermagic to control the board while deploying threats like Grief, Troll of Khazad-dûm, and Murktide Regent. The deck also includes value creatures like Snapcaster Mage and Baleful Strix to generate card advantage. The manabase is designed to support the deck's three-color requirements, with a mix of fetch lands and dual lands. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a victory.

The focus of this deck is to assemble a powerful combo using Mystic Forge and various mana acceleration cards to generate infinite mana and draw through the deck with Echo of Eons. The inclusion of Karn, the Great Creator allows for additional versatility in accessing artifacts, while Defense Grid helps protect the combo from disruption. By utilizing cards like Mesmeric Orb and Lion's Eye Diamond, this deck aims to create a fast and consistent win condition through the use of artifacts and combos.

The main concept of this deck is to rapidly deploy large threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan using cascade triggers. By using cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Elvish Spirit Guide to reduce mana costs, the deck is able to quickly cast cards with cascade like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent to put pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect its own threats. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Brazen Borrower provides versatility in dealing with opposing threats.

The main idea of this deck is to disrupt your opponent's mana base by playing cards like Blood Moon, Chalice of the Void, and Trinisphere. By shutting down their resources, you can quickly overwhelm them with aggressive creatures like Goblin Rabblemaster, Legion Warboss, and Magus of the Moon. With the help of cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox, you can accelerate your own mana production and secure a fast victory. The deck also utilizes powerful burn spells like Fury and Shatterskull Smashing to deal damage and control the board.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly assemble a combo of cards that allow the player to create a powerful board state or win condition. By utilizing cards like Gambit, Lotus Petal, Lion's Eye Diamond, and Echo of Eons, the player can generate mana and draw cards to find the necessary pieces of the combo. Once the combo is assembled, the player can win the game with cards like Grapeshot or Entomb. The inclusion of cards like Defense Grid and Ancient Tomb helps to protect and accelerate the combo.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the Dark Depths combo with Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token, while using cards like Crop Rotation and Green Sun's Zenith to tutor for key pieces. It also includes a package of utility lands and creatures like Knight of the Reliquary to support the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to win the game through the powerful synergy between Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage, while using cards like Swords to Plowshares and Mox Diamond for additional support.

The main idea of this deck is to establish a fast and aggressive board presence by utilizing cards that provide mana acceleration and disruptive effects. The deck aims to play threats with high impact for their cost early in the game, while also controlling the opponent's spells through Chalice of the Void and Archon of Emeria. By combining powerful creatures like Solitude with efficient removal spells like Touch the Spirit Realm, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents and secure victory. The inclusion of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Seasoned Dungeoneer provides additional card advantage and flexibility in gameplay.

The deck focuses on controlling the board by using a combination of removal spells like Snuff Out and creatures with disruptive abilities like Collector Ouphe. It aims to ramp up mana quickly through Gaea's Cradle and Green Sun's Zenith to bring out powerful threats such as Craterhoof Behemoth or Grist, the Hunger Tide. The deck also utilizes the toolbox aspect of Fiend Artisan to search for specific creatures like Endurance or Allosaurus Shepherd to disrupt the opponent's game plan. This strategy allows the deck to adapt to different matchups and control the flow of the game.

The deck aims to establish board control and out-value opponents through recursion and creature synergies. By utilizing cards like Veteran Explorer to ramp and Cabal Therapy to disrupt opponents' strategies, the deck can efficiently cast powerful threats like Magister of Worth and Meren of Clan Nel Toth. The inclusion of versatile cards like Fiend Artisan and Kaya, Orzhov Usurper further enhances the deck's versatility and resiliency. Additionally, the deck's toolbox of powerful creatures and planeswalkers provides various ways to generate advantage and dominate the game.

The main concept of this Dragon Stompy deck is to quickly disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and Chalice of the Void, while ramping out aggressive threats like Goblin Rabblemaster and Legion Warboss. The use of fast mana sources like Ancient Tomb and Chrome Mox allows for explosive starts, and additional burn spells like Shatterskull Smashing and Fury can finish off opponents quickly. The inclusion of Den of the Bugbear and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional threats and resilience against removal.

The main idea of this Cephalid Breakfast Legacy deck is to combo off by using Nomads en-Kor and Cephalid Illusionist to mill through your deck, eventually getting Thassa's Oracle onto the battlefield to win the game. The deck also includes control elements like Force of Will and Orim's Chant to protect the combo, as well as some value cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Urza's Saga to help set up the win condition. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win before the opponent can stop it.

This deck focuses on aggressively controlling the board with efficient removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Swords to Plowshares, while also disrupting opponents with countermagic like Spell Pierce and Force of Will. It looks to maintain card advantage and dig for answers through card draw effects like Brainstorm and Ponder. The creatures in the deck, like Baleful Strix and Snapcaster Mage, help apply pressure and provide additional utility. The mana base is streamlined and efficient to support the multicolored spells and ensure consistency in casting the spells.
